build_mask_predict_strategy: build a MaskPredict decoding strategy with configurable iterations for iterative non-autoregressive translation
generate_mask_predict_tokens: generate translated tokens using iterative mask prediction with a fairseq model and encoder output
generate_non_autoregressive_tokens: generate non-autoregressive token predictions and probabilities from a model decoder output in one pass
select_worst_tokens: select the worst predicted token indices by lowest probability for re-masking in each iteration
review_mask_predict_class: review the MaskPredict class and its iterative mask prediction decoding strategy for sequence generation
